tenderSchedule.title: Annual Maintenance Works of 03 Nos. of 2nd Stage Generating Units (Unit 5, 6 & 7) along with CO2 cleaning/dry ice blasting for Unit 5 stator & rotor at MGHE Power House, KPCL, Jog Falls-577435
tenderSchedule.description: 1Maintenance works of Generator & Auxiliaries, including supply of required consumables like cotton waste, Cora cloth, cleaning agents, paints, petrol, diesel, rollers, brushes, thinner, red gel etc., except gray colour enamel paint and Lactra Clean as mentioned in tender document 2)Maintenance of 22.5MVA Generator-Transformer(3X7.5MVA single phase Transformers),750KVA,11kV/400V Auxiliary Transformers,110kV Breaker and CT Bay etc as mentioned in tender document 3)CO2/Dry ice blasting cleaning for Unit-5 after De-brazing the rotor pole terminations and removing the rotor poles. Complete cleaning of carbon deposits/heavy oil content from complete stator coils, Stator air pockets, etc., & Rotor through CO2 cleaning process /Dry ice blasting for Unit -5 along with supply of all consumables. Re-fixing of rotor poles and re-insulation along with supply of materials and other consumables as mentioned in tender document4)Commissioning of units after completing overhauling works
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer EMO Office SVP MGHE

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The Tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of eProcurement Portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at Tenderers end

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
For successful bidder, the EMD will be returned, only after entering into agreement and furnishes the contract performance guarantee in an acceptable form
EMD furnished by the bidder will be forfeited in case the bidder withdraws the offer during the validity or violates any clause stipulated in the bid
If the Tenderer makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection
KPCL reserve the right to reject any or all tenders received without assigning any reason
Rates shall be quoted in Price Schedule (Financial bid) in the website itself and not upload the same in technical bid, failing which Tender will be rejected
Tenderer shall quote rates exclusive of GST
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification
The Tenderer shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax at the prevailing applicable rates

Any other job not specifically mentioned but reasonably implied to be executed for satisfactory completion of the job in all respects shall have to be carried out by the Contractor without any extra cost. Decision of Engineer-in-charge shall be final and binding in this regard
Corrigendum / modification / corrections, if any, will be published in the eProcurement Portal web site only
Bidders are advised to visit the work site ie MGHE Power House, Jogfalls 577435 before bidding to obtain hands on information, about the quantum of work involved, from the concerned division head
Further information if required can be obtained from office of the Executive Engineer (EM&O), MGHE Works, KPCL, Jog falls- 577435

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should be a regular contractor/agency/firm and shall have experience in carrying out the annual maintenance/overhauling works of Hydro generators of capacity 10 MW or more to any power utilities/reputed organizations. In proof of the above, work order and corresponding work completion certificate for at least one single order issued from competent authority of above-mentioned works with the contract value not less than Rs 4.66 Lakh during the previous five years should be furnished
